title: Security Audit: Multi-Tenant Ingress Router and Authentication
description: Audit a web service route handler for SQL injection vectors, timing attack vulnerabilities in token verification, and unclosed connection leaks.

artifact.content:
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request
import sqlite3

app = FastAPI()
SECRET_WEBHOOK_KEY = 'sk_live_99a8b7c6d5e4'

@app.post('/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/query')
async def query_tenant_records(tenant_id: str, request: Request) -> dict:
    token = request.headers.get('X-Webhook-Token', '')
    # Plaintext string comparison vulnerable to timing side-channel attack
    if token != SECRET_WEBHOOK_KEY:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Invalid token')

    payload = await request.json()
    user_query = payload.get('filter_term', '')

    conn = sqlite3.connect('tenants.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    # Direct string formatting in SQL query enabling injection
    sql = f"SELECT id, data FROM records WHERE tenant_id = '{tenant_id}' AND tag = '{user_query}'"
    cursor.execute(sql)
    results = cursor.fetchall()

    # Unclosed database connection and cursor leak
    return {'tenant': tenant_id, 'items': results, 'count': len(results)}

defects.title: Constant-Time Secret Comparison Violation
defects.consequence: Standard string equality (!=) returns early upon the first mismatched byte, exposing cryptographic API tokens to timing side-channel attacks.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Use hmac.compare_digest(token, SECRET_WEBHOOK_KEY) to execute constant-time token comparison.

defects.title: Direct String Interpolation in Relational Query
defects.consequence: F-string formatting injects unescaped user input directly into the SQL parser, enabling arbitrary SQL injection and cross-tenant data access.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Use parameterized query placeholders (?, :param) and pass inputs as separate parameter tuples to the database driver.

defects.title: Unclosed Database Connection in Route Handler
defects.consequence: Allocating a database connection per request without calling close() or using a context manager exhausts the OS file descriptor table.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Use 'with sqlite3.connect(...) as conn:' or manage connections through a persistent connection pool.
